title: SICNU GEO RS LabSpec
description: Declarative specification of an undergraduate remote-sensing lab exercise. One file drives the guided workflow UI, headless execution (operator_id + params), auto-grading (grading_ref) and generated documentation (scripts/gen_lab_docs.py). Authoring guide: docs/labs/LABSPEC.md.

spec_version.description: LabSpec contract version; bump on breaking changes (see ADR 0146).

id.description: Canonical lab id; must equal the file name stem (<id>.lab.json). Zero-padded labNN keeps listings and generated docs in a stable order.

objective.description: Teaching objective, shown as the lab description in the guided workflow list.

prerequisites.description: Data the student must load before stepping through the lab (paths relative to the project root).

pipeline.description: Path (project-root relative) to the pipeline JSON used for auto-grading, e.g. data/pipelines/landsat_ndvi.json.

grading_ref.description: Optional; consumed by D4/D7 auto-grading. Drift-guarded: the referenced file must exist.

thinking_questions.description: Open questions printed in the generated lab document.

description_zh.description: Chinese step instructions (中文说明), the teaching body of the step.

operator_id.description: Processing Registry operator this step launches/executes; must resolve in the registry and params must match the operator schema.

params.description: Operator parameters (JobRequest.params); requires operator_id. Keys are drift-guarded against the operator descriptor's input ports.

action.description: UI-verb slot on the main window (Q_INVOKABLE/public slot) for steps with no operator, e.g. addRasterLayer. Mutually exclusive with operator_id.

teaching_note.description: Background theory the student should take away (printed in docs, shown as hint).

completion_hint.description: How the student knows the step is done.
